scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: You left the customer in unannounced dead air twice for over 30 seconds—at [04:08]–[04:56] (38s gap after saying 'Just a moment') and at [06:53]–[07:49] (46s gap after saying 'Hang on there')—without properly asking to place him on hold or thanking him for waiting upon return.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: After the customer explained his nuisance call problem at [00:39]–[01:07], you offered empathy at [01:18] but then only said 'Okay, I've got that noted down, let's open your voice features' at [01:31] without restating or summarizing his issue.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At [08:22], when the customer asked to log a spoofed CLI number (`0161 496 0821`), you deflected responsibility by stating 'Oh, CLI spoofing has nothing to do with S-Net, we don't deal with fraud lists—you'll have to take that up with Ofcom or Action Fraud yourself.'
